scientific_integrity: A proof of the exact finite Walsh sign-only L3 moment classification is included; computational enumeration corroborates finite cases but does not establish arbitrary-dimension statements.
scientific_limitations: Real unit-modulus signs only; neither arbitrary real magnitudes nor complex phases nor other exponents are classified. Older finite-group majorant literature may contain an equivalent formulation.
title: The six-character threshold for signed Walsh majorant reversal
